findings.text: Biggest gain: T10, +0.10 s for LEC L12 over RUS L16. Gets on the throttle 12 m earlier, exits 4 km/h faster.
Gain #2: T11, +0.10 s for LEC L12 over RUS L16. Brakes 10 m earlier, carries 6 km/h more minimum speed.
Gain #3: Start to T1, +0.08 s for LEC L12 over RUS L16. Reaches 6 km/h higher top speed.
Gain #4: T2, +0.07 s for RUS L16 over LEC L12. Carries 3 km/h more minimum speed, exits 12 km/h faster.
Gain #5: T15, +0.06 s for RUS L16 over LEC L12. Carries 10 km/h more minimum speed.
